catalogueOverview.headline: Equipment Catalogue
catalogueOverview.description: SmartGrid Surveying offers a comprehensive range of high-quality surveying and engineering equipment. All instruments are reliable, calibrated, and accurate to support your projects with precision.

equipmentCategories.headline: What We Offer
equipmentCategories.description: Browse our selection of professional surveying equipment and accessories.

items.title: FOIF A90 RTK GNSS
items.description: High-precision GNSS system with multi-constellation support delivering centimeter-level RTK accuracy for mapping and engineering surveys.

items.title: E-Survey E3L Total Station
items.description: 2” accuracy total station with 5000m range, ideal for construction layout, boundary surveys, and topographic mapping.

items.title: DTM 152M Total Station
items.description: Reliable and efficient total station for engineering and cadastral surveys with stable measurement performance.

items.title: Bosch GOL 32D Level
items.description: 32x automatic level for precise construction leveling, grading, and site works with excellent optical clarity.

items.title: Huepar ALX32 Level
items.description: Affordable 32x automatic level offering reliable accuracy for construction and general leveling tasks.

items.title: DJI Air 3S
items.description: Next-gen mid-range mapping drone with a dual-camera system, ~40-45 min flight time, and stable grids for rapid mapping and inspection workflows.
